page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2ne.4xlarge is a general-purpose instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated physical cores and 16 vCPUs using the x86_64 architecture, specifically utilizing the Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz. The processor includes 32 KB of L1d cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 35 MB of L3 cache, with support for AVX, AVX512F, AES, and FMA instruction sets. The instance is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and it offers a baseline network bandwidth of 3 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates a clear performance tradeoff between single-core and multi-core execution. Single-core CPU performance is weak, with stress-ng and Geekbench single-core scores falling into the bottom 25% and 10% respectively. Single-threaded tasks like gzip and bzip3 compression also register in the bottom 10%. Conversely, multi-core performance is consistently average, placing in the middle 50% for stress-ng multi-core, Geekbench multi-core, and Passmark CPU tests. Memory bandwidth for both cached small blocks and uncached large blocks remains in the average tier.

Given the dedicated CPU allocation and balanced memory-to-vCPU ratio, this instance provides stable resource density for multi-threaded workloads. It achieves average throughput in static web serving (7.81 GB/sec) and Redis SET operations (11.29 million operations/sec), making it suitable for general-purpose web serving, database operations, and multi-threaded software compilation. However, it is less efficient for single-threaded processing or large-scale LLM inference, where its medium model (7B) prompt processing and text generation speeds are weak.
